host.coreml_threads: runtime managed; no public thread-count setting
host.compute_assignment: requested units; per-operation hardware placement is not measured

float16.packaging_normalization: Post-measurement UUIDv5 manifest IDs and deterministic protobuf serialization only; graph values and weights unchanged.

int8.packaging_normalization: Post-measurement UUIDv5 manifest IDs and deterministic protobuf serialization only; graph values and weights unchanged.

palette4.packaging_normalization: Post-measurement UUIDv5 manifest IDs and deterministic protobuf serialization only; graph values and weights unchanged.

int8-float32.packaging_normalization: Post-measurement UUIDv5 manifest IDs and deterministic protobuf serialization only; graph values and weights unchanged.

method.scope: synchronous Python MLModel.predict including input/output bridge; excludes detection, resizing and load
method.ordering: serial by compute-unit and variant; input order rotates one place per round
method.load: package load/compile, with pre-existing compiler caches; descriptive only, not cold-start benchmark
